description: Implementation of an encryption utility class providing AES encryption/decryption methods with CBC mode and PKCS5Padding. It handles encryption and decryption of strings using a secret key and IV, with internal utility methods for hexadecimal conversions.

classes.name: EncryptionImpl
classes.description: A final class implementing encryption and decryption methods for AES encryption with CBC mode, including helper methods for hex encoding and decoding.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a string value using AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding with the specified secret key and IV, returning a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a hexadecimal encrypted string back to plain text using AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding.

methods.name: bytesToHex
methods.description: Converts a byte array to its hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: hexToBytes
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string into its byte array equivalent.

methods.name: getSecretKey
methods.description: Returns the secret key used for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: setSecretKey
methods.description: Sets the secret key used for encryption/decryption.
